description: Comparison the monitoring data of an on-site stormwater detention (OSD) and the results in the use of theoretical methods for its design is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Pedro De Paula Drumond, Priscilla Macedo Moura. ABSTRACT On-site stormwater detention – OSD has been constructed in big Brazilian cities, as a way to reduce the impact of urbanization on the drainage system. However, there are a few studies about its efficiency in real scale. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 773639 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
